personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 3 Editorial Mobile typography and warmth
personality_one_liner: A premium, warm, and trustworthy platform that uses elegant typography and earth-toned colors to tell human stories, backed by clear, authoritative verification structures.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use safe-area for root elements. Maintain at least 16px padding on screen edges.

do's: Use on bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind it
Use on sticky CTAs fixed at the bottom of Campaign Details or Donation flow
Use on featured hero cards overlaying campaign images
dont's: Do not use on regular campaign cards in feed
Do not use on text-heavy form areas
Do not rely solely on glass without a proper translucent tinted base for readability

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Discover trustworthy causes effortlessly via engaging editorial cards.

states.loading: Skeleton cards with soft pulsing opacity
states.empty: Branded illustration of community hands + 'No causes found' + 'Create one' CTA
states.error: Human readable 'Something went wrong' + Retry button

screens.layout: Vertical ScrollView. 1. Greeting header (sans-serif). 2. 'Featured' section: Hero-sized cards with large image, bottom gradient scrim, title, and determinate progress bar (text: '₦1.5M of ₦2M'). 3. Horizontal scrolling category chips. 4. Vertical list of standard campaign cards. Single column filling width.

screens.name: Campaign Details
screens.purpose: Tell the human story, establish absolute trust, and drive donations.
screens.layout: Vertical ScrollView with fixed Safe-Area bottom container for 'Support this cause' CTA. 1. Full-bleed Hero Image at top. 2. Title (Fraunces). 3. Organizer row with Avatar + compact Verified badge. 4. Progress bar with exact numbers. 5. 'Trust Card': dedicated surfaceSecondary block showing specific verification checks (Identity: Verified, Funds: Secured). 6. Story & Budget. 7. Fixed glassmorphism CTA bottom bar.

screens.name: Donation Flow
screens.purpose: Frictionless, step-by-step contribution to a campaign.

states.error: Inline red text below failed step

screens.layout: Presented as a sheet or focused screen. Step 1: Preset amount grid (₦1,000 / ₦2,500 / ₦5,000 / ₦10,000 / Custom) wrapping beautifully. Step 2: Public/Anonymous toggle and message. Bottom anchored primary CTA inside a fixed container. Success state replaces view with a Shareable Impact Card.

screens.name: Create Flow
screens.purpose: Guide the organizer through a trusted, clear 9-step campaign builder.
screens.layout: Thin determinate progress bar anchored to the top header ('Step 2 of 9'). Main content uses card-based layout (one idea per card/step). Forms are stacked vertically. Sticky 'Next' / 'Submit' CTA at the bottom in KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Impact Dashboard
screens.purpose: Celebrate the user's giving journey through warm, human language.

states.empty: Warm illustration + 'Start your giving journey today'

screens.layout: Editorial-style stats display. Large display numbers (Fraunces). 'You have contributed...' instead of sterile 'Total: X'. List of recently followed/supported campaigns below.

hero_school.alt: Brown and black concrete community school building

empty_state.alt: Community hands gathered together in support

instructions_to_main_agent: NO BLUE, INDIGO, OR PURPLE HUES anywhere in the app, including gradients. Stick to the Warm Rust/Terracotta palette provided.

Implement the Trust Card on the Campaign Details screen explicitly: do not rely on color alone; pair verification text with solid iconography (e.g., Feather's check-circle or shield). It must look authoritative.

For all images that contain text overlay (like the hero cards in the Home feed or Campaign Details cover), apply a vertical linear-gradient scrim (transparent at 0% to 70%+ surfaceInverse at 100%) to ensure WCAG AA contrast for the text.
Ensure the CTA on Campaign Details and the Donation flow is sticky at the bottom, using Safe Area and a glassmorphism (or solid surface) background to prevent scroll collision.
Progress bars must be determinate (never looping/indeterminate) and paired with clear text values (e.g., '₦1.5M of ₦2M'), not just a percentage.
Never use raw system fonts; integrate 'Fraunces' for display/headings and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for text/UI.
Use custom SVGs or strictly @expo/vector-icons (Feather). Emojis are strictly banned from the UI.
For dark mode implementation, utilize the `_dark` suffix color tokens specified in the color block.
Research Insight: Break donation process into short step-by-step sequences. Monolithic donation forms cause abandonment. Post-donation, immediately provide pre-formatted, clean share cards.
Research Insight: Keep verification badges compact and un-animated. Avoid badge inflation; only show Verified when specific criteria are met.
